titles.title: Ab Tak Chhappan 2
titles.plot: After his wife is murdered, encounter specialist Sadhu Agashe goes into self-proclaimed exile to ensure his son's safety, but the home minister urges him to return to tackle Mumbai's escalating crime scene.

titles.title: Akilla's Escape
titles.plot: A drug dealer finds his moral code challenged when he interrupts an armed robbery and captures one of the gang members who is a 15-year-old boy.

titles.title: Andhadhun
titles.plot: A series of mysterious events changes the life of a blind pianist who must report a crime that he should technically know nothing about.

titles.title: Arkansas
titles.plot: A series of mistakes leads to a deadly collision between two criminals and a drug kingpin in Arkansas.

titles.title: Awake
titles.plot: A man wakes up in a hospital bed having no idea who he is. He learns that he is wanted for committing a series of murders.

titles.title: Badlapur
titles.plot: Years after his wife and son are murdered, Raghu finds out who pulled the trigger and sets out for revenge.

titles.title: Black Out
titles.plot: A retired criminal (Raymond Thiry) must figure out what happened to a murder victim and retrieve a drug lord's cocaine or else the life of his bride-to-be is forfeit.

titles.title: Bob the Gambler
titles.plot: In Paris, Bob Montagne (Roger Duchesne) is practically synonymous with gambling -- and winning. He is kind, classy and well-liked by virtually everyone in town, including police inspector Ledru (Guy Decomble). However, when Bob's luck turns sour, he begins to lose friends and makes the most desperate gamble of his life: to rob the Deauville casino during Grand Prix weekend, when the vaults are full. Unfortunately, Bob soon learns that the game is rigged and the cops are on to him.

titles.title: Bullet Head
titles.plot: Three career criminals find themselves trapped in a warehouse with the law closing in and an even worse threat waiting inside.

titles.title: Cardinals
titles.plot: A woman returns home from prison after serving a sentence for killing her neighbor in a drunken driving accident. She wants to move on, but it becomes clear that the past is not easily forgotten when the deceased woman's son shows up on her doorstep.

titles.title: Chapel
titles.plot: After awakening from a coma with no memory, Cohen falls for his nurse, Sofia, but their lives take a dark turn when they discover a dead body. Soon, the arrival of Detective Wyatt, sparks a dangerous game of cat and mouse. Unable to recall his past Cohen flees to a seedy motel where he meets the enigmatic 10 o'clock Jack and indulges in a steamy affair with a mysterious guest named Misha. As Detective Wyatt closes in on his true identity, the clock ticks down, and Cohen realizes that the web of deceit is far more sinister than he ever could have imagined. If he doesn't confront his troubled past and unravel it soon, it may be too late for everyone involved.

titles.title: Christmas in Wonderland
titles.plot: Crooks and cops pursue a brother and sister who found a bag of counterfeit cash while shopping in a Canadian mall.

titles.title: Crown and Anchor
titles.plot: A haunted police officer returns to his hometown for his mother's funeral. He's forced to confront his estranged cousin, who has become a drug-using criminal.

titles.title: Dutch
titles.plot: DUTCH introduces a player who will use any means necessary to dominate the streets and beyond. For Bernard James, Jr. aka "Dutch" (Lance Gross), survival is the ultimate score and power is the deadliest high of all. There isn't an angle he can't work or a woman he can't seduce. When he gains control of an African drug lord's stolen heroin business, Dutch quickly makes it the most feared drug empire on the East Coast. Naturally, there are plenty of enemies vowing to take him down, including a vengeful Mafia heir, an ambitious DA and a conscience-stricken former friend. With Dutch fighting for his life, while on trial, he plays the game and scores a winning hand in the face of all that betrayed him and finds justice his way... the street way!

titles.title: Fargo
titles.plot: "Fargo" is a reality-based crime drama set in Minnesota in 1987. Jerry Lundegaard (William H. Macy) is a car salesman in Minneapolis who has gotten himself into debt and is so desperate for money that he hires two thugs (Steve Buscemi), (Peter Stormare) to kidnap his own wife. Jerry will collect the ransom from her wealthy father (Harve Presnell), paying the thugs a small portion and keeping the rest to satisfy his debts. The scheme collapses when the thugs shoot a state trooper.

titles.title: Finding Steve McQueen
titles.plot: The FBI launches its biggest manhunt when an unlikely gang of thieves tries to steal $30 million in illegal campaign contributions from President Richard Nixon's secret fund.

titles.title: Fire With Fire
titles.plot: A firefighter does something unexpected after a man that he has been ordered to testify against threatens him.

images.caption: Bruce Willis as Mike Cella in "Fire with Fire."

titles.title: Flinch
titles.plot: Joe Doyle (Daniel Zovatto) is a young hitman, like his father before him, who lives with his mother Gloria (Academy Award nominee Cathy Moriarty). By day he follows his victims, getting to know their every move, by night he watches old movies and browses social media. While chasing his new target, city council member Ed Terzian (Tom Segura), Doyle falls for the councilman's assistant Mia (Tilda Cobham-Hervey). When she accidentally witnesses the murder of her boss, Doyle becomes conflicted about what he should do with her -- so he takes her back to his house until he can figure things out. Concerned only for her son's life, Gloria wants Mia dead, while Doyle's employer, Lee (David Proval), and his son, James (Buddy Duress), pressure Doyle about the missing girl. Doyle comes to find there is more than meets the eye with Mia, making it nearly impossible for Doyle to navigate the most trying conundrum of his life: catching feelings.

titles.title: God's Petting You
titles.plot: A heroin addict falls in love with a struggling sex addict, and together the pair hatch a plan to steal a small fortune from a porn star.

titles.title: Gun-Shy
titles.plot: A loner who spends his time volunteering for meals on wheels meets an intriguing girl who becomes his best friend. When he discovers that she's in a relationship with her stepfather, he becomes obsessed with idea of saving her.

titles.title: Gutterbug
titles.plot: A young man grapples with being homeless until he decides to find his way home.

titles.title: Happy Times
titles.plot: A seemingly friendly dinner party erupts into a night of violence and terror at a lush Hollywood estate.

titles.title: I Don't Feel at Home in This World Anymore
titles.original_title: I Don't Feel at Home in This World Anymore
titles.plot: After being burglarized, a depressed woman (Melanie Lynskey) and her obnoxious neighbor set out to find the thieves, but they soon find themselves up against a group of dangerous criminals.

trailer.title: I Don't Feel at Home in This World Anymore: Trailer 1

titles.title: Police Story 2013
titles.plot: While visiting his estranged daughter at a nightclub, a police captain must spring into action when a kidnapping plan unravels right before his eyes.

titles.title: Juggernaut
titles.plot: After discovering the news that his mother has taken her life, Saxon Gamble returns home, irrationally plagued by the notion that her death was not a suicide. Saxon, a man of violence, embarks on a revenge mission that shakes up the quiet town where he was born. His quest also awakens a dormant sibling rivalry that leads him on a collision course with his brother.

titles.title: Knuckle City
titles.plot: A fading boxer's quest for redemption endangers himself and his family.

titles.title: The Unknown Woman
titles.plot: A Russian woman (Kseniya Rappoport) keeps her true motives hidden when she worms her way into the home of a wealthy Italian family.

titles.title: Les misérables
titles.plot: Members of a Parisian anti-crime squad become overwhelmed by simmering neighborhood tension and violence.

titles.title: Looted
titles.plot: Rob (Charley Palmer Rothwell - Legend), loves driving and stealing cars, living his life at a hundred miles an hour in the cash-starved port town he calls home. He shares a house with his dying father (Tom Fisher - The Young Victoria) who thinks he's out job hunting. Rob manages to keep his two worlds perfectly separated until best mate Leo (Thomas Turgoose - This Is England), gets him involved in a bigger, riskier job which goes terribly wrong. With his relationship with his distant father in shreds and betrayed by his best mate, unexpected hope comes from Leo's girlfriend Kasia (Morgane Polanski - Vikings).

titles.title: Machine Gun McCain
titles.plot: California mobster Charlie Adamo (Peter Falk) pulls strings to get his old lieutenant, Hank McCain (John Cassavetes), out of the prison where he's spent 12 years for armed robbery. McCain's son, Jack (Pierluigi Apra), who took his place in Adamo's organization, sets up a heist at a Las Vegas casino that Adamo tries to stop when he learns a rival mob boss runs the joint. Pulling the casino job with the help of his newfound love, Irene (Britt Ekland), Jack has to outrun his Mafia pursuers.

titles.title: Mardaani
titles.plot: After child traffickers kidnap a beloved teenager, a Mumbai policewoman (Rani Mukerji) embarks on a personal mission to bring the vile perpetrators to justice.

titles.title: Matchstick Men
titles.plot: Roy (Nicolas Cage), a depressed con artist with obsessive-compulsive disorder, and Frank (Sam Rockwell), his partner, find their line of work complicated by the arrival of Roy's teenage daughter, Angela (Alison Lohman). Angela brings some spirit back into Roy's life, and some of his disorder symptoms seem to disappear. But when Angela wants to learn the family business, and Roy allows her to assist on a big scam concerning a businessmen (Bruce McGill), he reconsiders his parenting techniques.

titles.title: Memories of Murder
titles.plot: In 1986, Park (Song Kang-ho) and Cho (Kim Roi-ha) were two simple-minded detectives assigned to a double murder investigation in a South Korean province. But when the murderer strikes several more times with the same pattern, the detectives realize that they are chasing the country's first documented serial killer. Relying on only their basic skills and tools, Park and Cho attempt to piece together the clues and solve the case in this thriller based on true events.

titles.title: Mob Town
titles.plot: The FBI and a local cop track various members of organized crime families as they gather for a huge meeting in upstate New York in 1957.

titles.title: Murder, She Said
titles.plot: When aging sleuth Miss Marple (Margaret Rutherford) witnesses a murder through the window of her passing train car, she alerts the authorities. Unfortunately, the police are hesitant to take the word of an old lady in lieu of an actual body. Taking matters into her own hands, Marple gets a job as a maid at Ackenthorpe Hall, where she believes the murder took place. There, she must match wits with blowhard Luther Ackenthorpe (James Robertson Justice) if she wants to solve the mystery.

titles.title: Naam Hai Akira
titles.plot: A college student (Sonakshi Sinha) single-handedly takes on four corrupt police officers in a bid to prove her innocence.

titles.title: Nameless Gangster
titles.plot: A corrupt customs officer steals a confiscated shipment of methamphetamine and partners with a crime boss to start a business.

titles.title: The Man of the Year
titles.plot: In the slums of Brazil, timid Máiquel (Murilo Benício) must endure the shame of bleaching his hair after a pal defeats him in a wager. Upon getting the dreaded makeover, he suddenly feels unusually self-assured and so invites Cledir (Cláudia Abreu), a hairstylist he just met, to have a drink. They run into trouble in the form of a thug, but Máiquel unexpectedly guns him down. Strangely, he is praised for the crime, and despite his objections, he finds himself thrust into the role of vigilante.

titles.title: Pimp
titles.plot: A pimp in the ghettos of the Bronx, N.Y., dreams of a better life for herself and her girlfriend. She soon gets caught in a fierce battle when she comes face to face with a rival who runs an even more dangerous game.

titles.title: Piranhas
titles.plot: Six 15-year-old boys deal drugs and use assault rifles to rule their neighborhood in Naples, interested only in making money, wearing designer clothes and surviving in a world where they believe they have no future.

titles.title: Players
titles.plot: A thief asks his mentor for help when a DVD clue from a dead friend tips him off to one of the largest heists of the century.

titles.title: Raees
titles.plot: Threat looms over bootlegger Raees Alam and his business after ACP Majmudar decides to get the better of him. In order to survive and keep his trade thriving, Raees must overcome these obstacles.

titles.title: Rocky Handsome
titles.plot: A vengeful man (John Abraham) embarks on a murderous rampage after the kidnapping of a 7-year-old girl.

titles.title: Saving Mr. Wu
titles.plot: Police race against time after criminals posing as cops kidnap a Hong Kong movie star (Andy Lau) and threaten to kill him.

titles.title: The Spanish Prisoner
titles.plot: Everything changes for rising corporate star Joe Ross (Campbell Scott) when he meets the wealthy and mysterious Jimmy Dell (Steve Martin) at a tropical resort. Dell offers to help Ross protect his new business process invention, but in short order Ross finds himself falsely accused of murder. Working with the FBI and his assistant, Susan Ricci (Rebecca Pidgeon), Ross sets out to prove his innocence and disentangle himself from the diabolical entrapment.

titles.title: Special 26
titles.plot: A gang of thieves robs famous businessmen and politicians by posing as income tax officers.

titles.title: Suburra
titles.plot: Criminal rivalries and endemic corruption are exposed when plans are made to turn a seaside town into a gambling paradise.

titles.title: Summer of Changsha
titles.plot: A detective on a murder case falls in love with a surgeon he meets during the investigation.

titles.title: The Scenesters
titles.plot: A crime-scene cleaner (Blaise Miller), a videographer and investigators collaborate on a secret documentary about a serial killer's crimes.

titles.title: The Belly of the Whale
titles.plot: Desperate for cash, a teenager who is in debt and a troubled 50-year-old man team up to rob a local arcade and rid themselves of their money woes.

titles.title: The Big Ugly
titles.plot: London mob bosses invest in a West Virginia oil deal in hopes of laundering dirty money.

titles.title: The Brooklyn Banker
titles.plot: A banker with a gift for memorizing numbers is caught up in a mobster's bid for power.

images.caption: Troy Garity as Santo in "The Brooklyn Banker."
Paul Sorvino as Benny in "The Brooklyn Banker."
Paul Sorvino as Benny in "The Brooklyn Banker."

titles.title: The Hate U Give
titles.plot: Starr Carter is constantly switching between two worlds -- the poor, mostly black neighborhood where she lives and the wealthy, mostly white prep school that she attends. The uneasy balance between these worlds is soon shattered when she witnesses the fatal shooting of her childhood best friend at the hands of a police officer. Facing pressure from all sides of the community, Starr must find her voice and decide to stand up for what's right.

titles.title: The River Thief
titles.plot: A reckless teenage drifter (Joel Courtney) endangers the lives of a man (Tommy Cash) and his granddaughter (Raleigh Cain) after stealing money from a drug dealer.

images.caption: (L-R) Joel Courtney as Diz and Raleigh Cain as Selah in "The River Thief."

titles.title: The Seven-Ups
titles.plot: Buddy Manucci (Roy Scheider) is a tough New York City cop who operates as part of an unconventional team called "The Seven-Ups" that uses drastic measures to bring criminals to justice. When Vito Lucia (Tony Lo Bianco), one of Manucci's street contacts, uses a classified police list to kidnap mobsters and hold them for ransom, it sets off a series of escalating conflicts. After a member of Manucci's unit is killed in the ensuing violence, the cop and his crew stop at nothing to get Lucia.

titles.title: The Wannabe
titles.plot: An aspiring gangster and his new girlfriend embark on a crime spree against the mob in the 1990s New York.

titles.title: Vishwaroopam
titles.plot: Nirupama marries a dance instructor and she wants to end the marriage after three years to pursue her higher education.

titles.title: Wallflower
titles.plot: A man planning to commit a mass shooting is befriended by an eccentric group of ravers and finds himself conflicted about his intentions.

titles.title: Wazir
titles.plot: A brave ATS officer (Farhan Akhtar) and a disabled grandmaster (Amitabh Bachchan) face a mysterious and dangerous opponent (Manav Kaul).

titles.title: Yardie
titles.plot: A man's quest for retribution brings him into conflict with a vicious London gangster.
